data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 conflates two distinct relations under a single 'shared mechanism' label. The first clause asserts a REDUCTION ('reduces to a single abstract mechanism'), while the second clause describes ABSTRACTION ('abstracts both ... into a unified pre-call barrier'). These are different relation kinds with different logical commitments: reduction requires the abstract mechanism to be necessary-and-sufficient for the originals, while abstraction merely requires a common generalization. The target never disambiguates which relation it is actually proposing, making the substantive claim untestable as stated. The problem demands naming the kind of relation, not layering two incompatible kinds in the same proposal.
